messages.author: 8dbb28b015bb7762
messages.subject: error dependent on the system
parts:
Hi,

I'm having problems running the sample code from
http://www.r-inla.org/models/tools#TOC-Models-where-the-response-data-depe
The curious thing is that it seems to fail only in 64bit systems (I
tested this using the same R and INLA versions on two 64bit systems and
three 32 bit systems).

I debugged the problem down to line 57 of inla.predictor.section:
A[is.na(A)] = 0
where A is a sparse matrix.

And I discovered that the following test code worked well on 32bit
computers but fails on 64bit computers.

library(Matrix)
A <- matrix(1:9, ncol=3)
A = as(A, "dgTMatrix")
A[A>7] = 0

it gives the following error on the 64bit machines I've tested it on.
Error en .local(x, i, j, ..., value) :
not-yet-implemented 'Matrix[<-' method

Which was the error I had when running INLA.

Bests
ï¿½acu.-
